objective.name: sandbox.cpp.echo
objective.description: Compiled wrapper-backed echo capacity for Execution N6 tests

#root.role: Build if needed, run the compiled wrapper, and return an echoed message.

effects.wrapper_build: The compiled wrapper may be built or rebuilt.
effects.wrapper_runtime: The compiled wrapper runtime may be started lazily.

transformation_contract.morphing: An echoed message request becomes a wrapper-produced echo after the compiled execution path has ensured a runnable build artifact.
invariants: sandbox.cpp.echo must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.cpp.echo returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.cpp.echo fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
